ops.title: corten gate staging: pinned artifacts, APNs-egress finding, corten ops facts (G1 prep 2026-07-18)
ops.body:
G1 (corten gate) prep completed 2026-07-18; everything staged under `~/.yclaw/scratch/corten-gate/` on the host (bin/, configs/, notes/ — `notes/REMAINING-STEPS.md` is the continuation map). Scratch guest `corten-gate` (debian bookworm-slim, 2 CPU/2 GB) live at 192.168.72.5 on the default container bridge; **the guest IP is baked into tuwunel.toml's bind list** — recreate the guest ⇒ update the config.

**Pinned artifacts (verified live):**
- corten-matrix: repo `lrhodin/corten-matrix`, tag `1.0.7` (**no `v` prefix**), asset `corten-matrix-linux-arm64`, 65484968 B, sha256 `060921b9dbbe4a44f92eb09013d02161884811413ffcd7d41781aaa9aadbdf1e`. ELF aarch64 dynamic (Go/cgo), needs only libm/libc/libresolv/libpthread/libdl (rustls in-binary), max glibc symbol GLIBC_2.28. Verified runnable in the guest.
- The extractor is a separate, repo-tree artifact (v1.0.7 ships NO extractor asset): commit-pinned zip `https://github.com/lrhodin/corten-matrix/raw/d9fed308b33a03019fd4273a6921a0a5bf818564/tools/extract-key-cli.zip`, zip sha256 `41ff44ee8db56affbcba16b88496a76f9b021b449cb1321485c1e9e40418384e`, inner `extract-key` (universal Mach-O) sha256 `078e56dd2151fb694b63c2654abdd569e97a0c2e4a3b641503288af0849156a0`. **Extraction is Apple-ID-agnostic** (hardware identifiers only — serial/MLB/board-id/_enc); the yclaw Apple ID + 2FA are entered at corten's interactive LOGIN, not extraction.
- tuwunel v1.8.2: used release asset `v1.8.2-release-all-aarch64-v8-linux-gnu-tuwunel.zst` (sha256 `e087ee1d…3597`; decompressed binary `cf05e397…15e4`) — **statically linked**, runs on any base. Official OCI channels exist (DockerHub `jevolk/tuwunel`, GHCR `ghcr.io/matrix-construct/tuwunel`) but the static binary suits co-location in one guest → **P7 packaging can fetchurl the static binary instead of nixpkgs/OCI**.

**APNs egress finding (gate-deciding):** from inside the container bridge, courier 5223 is BLOCKED and 443 PASSES (tested 1/10/20-courier.push.apple.com by name + literal 17.57.144.118; api.push.apple.com:443 passes). Host passes both ⇒ the block is our own `com.apple/000.yclaw.container` anchor tier-2. Fix: one tier-2 line passing tcp to `17.0.0.0/8 port 5223` (scoped to Apple's block — the shared anchor also governs hermes), landed with the P1 container-pf edit; applies at the next sudo anchor reload. Evidence: `~/.yclaw/scratch/corten-gate/notes/apns-egress.md`.

**corten ops facts:** external-key login mode has NO config fields — hardware key + Apple ID + 2FA are entered interactively (README Quick Start (Linux) step 3) and persist in the bridge DB. `corten-matrix -e` emits the canonical config; `-g` generates the appservice registration (real as/hs tokens, exclusive @imessagebot/@imessage_* namespaces, ephemeral events on); `init-db` runs offline (sqlite materializes lazily on first start). The CLI's start/install-service targets systemd — inside containers run `corten-matrix -c <config>` directly (matches vault's svc() pattern). tuwunel config: registration token-gated (token at `configs/tuwunel-registration-token.txt` — fully-closed registration would leave no way to mint the gate's admin/test account); appservice_dir `/etc/tuwunel/appservices`; federation off; E2EE allow=false for the bridge.

Tuwunel is LIVE in the guest (versions endpoint answers from the host; appservice whoami returns the sender bot). Corten staged NOT started — stopped exactly where the hardware key is needed. Full arc: acct-12 plan `now-that-metal-is-tingly-planet.md`; decision note 91cb1b5f.
